name: Norrsent - Agentic Risk Management & GRC
description: Norrsent MCP connects Claude to your enterprise risk management (ERM) and GRC workspace on Norrsent. Query and analyze your risk register, controls and their effectiveness, Key Risk Indicators (KRIs), mitigations, active threats, governance policies, incidents, your organizational hierarchy, and the aggregated risk matrix and update a risk or report an incident that are all bounded by your own role-based permissions and recorded in an access audit log.

_published_faq.name: How do I add Norrsent - Agentic Risk Management & GRC to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor?

acceptedAnswer.text: Add Norrsent - Agentic Risk Management & GRC to Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor by connecting its remote MCP URL in each client's MCP settings. In Claude, add a custom connector. In ChatGPT, add an MCP app. In Cursor, add an MCP server under Settings. The MCP URL is https://api.norrsent.com/mcp. This server requires OAuth, so complete the login prompt after you connect.

_published_faq.name: What tools does the Norrsent - Agentic Risk Management & GRC MCP server provide?

acceptedAnswer.text: Norrsent - Agentic Risk Management & GRC lists 16 MCP tools, including company_tree, create_incident, get_enterprise_matrix, get_incident, get_incident_stats, get_policy, get_risk, list_controls, list_incidents, list_kris, list_mitigations, and list_policies.

_published_faq.name: What are the best alternatives to Norrsent - Agentic Risk Management & GRC?

acceptedAnswer.text: As of October 18, 2026, alternatives to Norrsent - Agentic Risk Management & GRC in productivity on the Manufact MCP catalog include Autodesk Product Help, BoardWise, FlagStat, Keenable Web Search, and PomoDial.

_published_faq.name: Does Norrsent - Agentic Risk Management & GRC MCP require authentication?

acceptedAnswer.text: Norrsent - Agentic Risk Management & GRC requires authentication. Connect it in Claude, ChatGPT, or Cursor and complete the OAuth login prompt.

_published_faq.name: Who develops Norrsent - Agentic Risk Management & GRC?

acceptedAnswer.text: Norrsent - Agentic Risk Management & GRC is developed by Norrsent. It is listed as community on the Claude connector directory.
